english: Add creates a disconnected server. Connect also starts the connection. Basic or Advanced changes which connection fields are shown. Cancel discards the form.
Apply uses staged preferences now. Save also writes them to the configuration file. Back returns to the settings groups. Cancel closes the form and discards unapplied edits.

Commonly used prioritizes common tasks for the live connection. Recent history lists retained commands. Most used ranks this configuration's saved command-name counts. Alphabetical sorts names. Contextual uses the screen that opened command entry. Down selects; Enter inserts for review. Delete forgets a history entry or resets a personal count. Apply uses the mode now; Save keeps the choice.
